timestamp: UTC timestamp parsed from cache filename; no invented observation times

markets.cards: EXCLUDED: bookmaker total_cards semantics not proven equivalent to provider-yellow target

quote_requirements: both outcomes present, finite decimal odds > 1, snapshot before kickoff
snapshot_selection: latest eligible snapshot within each window; one quote per fixture-market-window
eligible_predictions: only V32.2 non-overlapping walk-forward test predictions; exact match_id and target identity
selection_policy: none; this audit does not choose bets, thresholds, leagues or winning arms
ev_policy: not a promotion criterion here; no retrospective bet selection from disagreement
closing_policy: H15M is near-close only, not claimed as genuine closing line
market_adjusted_model: not fitted in this audit; requires separately registered earlier-data blending and adequate quote coverage
